nodes.summary: Kahn–Kalai–Linial inequality for the uniform measure with constant `2` (J. Kahn, G. Kalai, N. Linial, *The influence of variables on Boolean functions*, FOCS 1988; proof after D. Falik, A. Samorodnitsky, 2007): for every finite nonempty `E` and every Boolean function `φ` on `{0, 1}^E`, `2 · Var(φ) · log (1 / maxₑ Infₑ(φ)) ≤ ∑ₑ Infₑ(φ)`, where `Infₑ(φ)` is the probability that `e` is pivotal. This is the `p = 1/2`…
